text:
Anya: Heads-up — EU telemetry shard replayed late into staging; agg-hours for 2026-11-03..2026-11-08 are undercounted in prod dashboards. Need a backfill plan.

Devon: How big is the delta? rough rows/GB? any malformed events?

Jordan: Initial diff from recon job: ~3.2M events, ~18GB raw, mostly short sessions. No schema drift; a few events missing session_id dropped at ingest.

Rachel: Note: Dedicated cluster quotas near-saturated this week. Full compute window will hit GPU/slot limits and disrupt realtime. Can we window it? :thinking_face: 

Devon: Proposal: chunk by day, lower concurrency + backoff. Use recompute scheduler with sequential windows and a canary day.

Devon: Steps:
1) run canary for 2026-11-03 only
2) verify dashboard diffs + tag anomalies
3) run remaining days 1/day, concurrency 2

Devon: Command to trigger canary (infra-run host):
```
recompute-scheduler trigger --dag agg_hours_recompute --start 2026-11-03 --end 2026-11-03 --concurrency 1 --tag=eu-latebackfill
```

Anya: Who owns canary validation? I can check dashboard deltas and eval prompt sets but need a reproducible checklist.

Jordan: I'll add a smoke script comparing hourly counts and top-10 buckets (model_id, route). Pushing to eng-platform repo under telemetry/tools/backfill_check.py

Rachel: Ops notes:
- Use idempotent writes / write-temp-then-rename to avoid partial replays double-counting in parquet tables
- Respect ingestion watermark so downstream doesn't re-ingest these rows as "late"

Devon: Also set dedupe key: (event_id) and ensure writer uses upsert semantics. Agg jobs dedupe on run_id which won't catch overlapping backfills.

Maya: FYI: EU S3 manifests in /replay/manifests/2026-11-eu/ — contain original offsets.

Devon: Throttle based on CPU/io from compute pool. Rachel, can you expose a temporary quota label for backfills (quota: backfill-eu=10%) so airflow tasks honor it?

Rachel: Adding quota label + admission check in recompute-scheduler. ETA 2h. Config under infra/quota/backfills.yaml

Anya: Console UX: surface backfill state and per-day progress in telemetry dashboard and rollouts page so PMs don't open tickets.

Jordan: I'll add endpoint telemetry-api: /backfills/{id}/progress returning days, status, processed_events, errors_count. Minimal.

Devon: Runbook (pin to #incidents when starting):
- kick canary
- wait for smoke (Jordan)
- confirm in dashboard (Anya)
- if mismatch > 0.5% escalate to eng-ml + support
- proceed sequentially

Anya: Timeline: canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, remaining 5 days start 12:00 UTC with 1hr spacing.

Sam: Will this change historical billing numbers in console? PMs need to know if user-visible metrics shift.

Devon: It will update aggregated usage (agg-hours). We'll add a console note: "Data for 2026-11-03..08 updated by backfill on 2026-11-09". Jordan to add endpoint for human-readable note.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: recompute-scheduler/agg_hours_eu_backfill (owner: devon). Next run: 1836123600 (canary)

Rachel: Pushed backfill quota and admission check. Added soft cap to prevent >50% concurrency spike. Test on canary.

Jordan: Pushed smoke check PR: telemetry/tools/backfill_check.py — uploads report to s3://redwood-telemetry/backfill-reports/1836123456-canary.json

Anya: I'll run canary, validate, and post results here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Devon: After canary + green, I'll run smaller concurrent batch to finish remaining days and monitor infra metrics. Run ownership: Devon.

Participants-note: action items: Anya(validate dashboards), Jordan(smoke script + API), Rachel(quota + admission), Devon(run jobs)
